tldr: Mercury in the 9th house routes the mind and voice through wisdom and expansion.
body: With Mercury in the 9th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through belief, faith, travel, higher learning, publishing, and meaning. This makes how you search for truth, widen your world, and live what you believe a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through wisdom and expansion.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in wisdom and expansion.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
